name: diagram
tagline_zh: 画图不用再开绘图软件：说清流程、架构或对比，自动挑 Mermaid、Excalidraw 或 Canvas 出图。
tagline_en: No more drawing tools: describe a process, structure, or comparison, and it picks Mermaid, Excalidraw, or Canvas.
desc_en: Generate a diagram from text, routing to Mermaid, Excalidraw, or Obsidian Canvas. Covers flowcharts, mindmaps, architecture and OKR trees, sequence and state diagrams, comparisons, timelines, and turning a PRD's written business flow into a diagram. Triggers on 画图, 流程图, 思维导图, 架构图, 对比图, 可视化, PRD流程图, 核心流程画图, diagram, flowchart, mindmap, Mermaid, Excalidraw, 动画图, animate, Canvas, .canvas.
why_zh: 它不只会画一种图，而是按内容自动选最合适的载体——流程图、思维导图、架构图、时序图都认。
why_en: It doesn't just draw one kind of diagram—it picks the best format for your content, from flowcharts to mindmaps to sequence.
limit_zh: 只认文本输入，不认手绘草图或图片；输出的是图源码或文件，不负责排版美化；复杂动画需另配工具，超出所列类型会提示重试。
limit_en: Text input only; no sketches or images. Outputs source code or files, not polished layouts. Complex animations need extra tools; unsupported types.
title_en: Text to diagram: Mermaid, Excalidraw, or Canvas
